description: This file defines the 'ShareAccountCharge' entity class, which models charges associated with share accounts in a financial application. It includes fields for charge details, payment status, amount calculations, and methods for managing the charge lifecycle such as payment, waiver, and updates.

classes.name: ShareAccountCharge
classes.description: Entity class representing a charge applied to a share account, with lifecycle management and calculation methods.

methods.name: createNewWithoutShareAccount
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ShareAccountCharge instance without associating it with a share account.

methods.name: markAsFullyPaid
methods.description: Marks the charge as paid in full, updating relevant fields.

methods.name: resetToOriginal
methods.description: Resets charge amounts and status to initial states, typically used for reprocessing or correction.

methods.name: undoPayment
methods.description: Reverts a payment transaction, adjusting paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Waives the charge, moving it from active to waived status and updating amounts.

methods.name: undoWaiver
methods.description: Reverts a waiver, restoring the charge to active status.

methods.name: pay
methods.description: Records a payment against the charge, updating paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the associated charge.

methods.name: currencyCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code of the associated charge.

methods.name: getCharge
methods.description: Returns the charge definition object.

methods.name: shareAccount
methods.description: Returns the associated ShareAccount object.

methods.name: isShareAccountActivation
methods.description: Returns true if the charge is for share account activation.

methods.name: isShareAccountClosure
methods.description: Returns true if the charge is for share account closure.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCodeOf
methods.description: Checks if the charge's currency code matches the provided code.

methods.name: updateWithdralFeeAmount
methods.description: Updates the fee amount based on transaction amount and calculation type.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates whether the charge is active.

methods.name: isNotActive
methods.description: Returns true if the charge is not active.

methods.name: getChargeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated charge.

methods.name: isSharesPurchaseCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for share purchase.

methods.name: isSharesRedeemCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for share redemption.

methods.name: getChargeTimeType
methods.description: Returns the charge time type as integer.

methods.name: deriveChargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates and updates the charge amount based on transaction and charge calculation type.

methods.name: updateChargeDetailsForAdditionalSharesRequest
methods.description: Updates the charge details for an additional shares request.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of this charge.
